title: Documentation updates
body:
By order of importance: (we might want to separate into different issues)

- [x] Components should always be "widgets". We always talk about widgets when manipulating Menu, RefinementList. Our only component being `<InstantSearch>` (not actually connected). There's no added value in making the distinction public
- [x] add copy paste to code samples (see places website)
- [x] fix indentation of code samples
- [x] switch to same syntax highligting as places website (GitHub colors). Current theme is not as readable when compared side by side.
- [x] fix syntax highliting (see getting started JSX)
~~- [ ] add line numbers~~
- [x] GitHub link should send to v2 branch
- [x] add a EDIT button on every page
